title: Research reports rebuilt on Claude with fact-checking
summary: The web research digest now runs on Claude Sonnet 4.5 with keyless search tools, featuring sourced fact-checking and editor passes to prevent misattribution.

sections.heading: New
items: Research agent rebuilt on Claude Sonnet 4.5 with keyless tools: HN full-text search and comments, engineering blog feeds, GitHub issues, arXiv, HTML/PDF reading
Prompt caching reduces cost per report from ~$3 to ~$0.50
20s timeout on tool calls to prevent PDF extraction hangs

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Reports fact-checked against cited sources to prevent misattribution and false claims
Editor pass runs on Opus 4.5 for stronger accuracy on detail alignment between similar sources
Research timeout increased to accommodate the fact-checking editor
HN keyword search excludes launches and self-promotion to improve signal
